title: Funny how justice feels holy… until it knocks on our friend’s door. 👀⚖️
paragraphs: Funny how justice feels holy… until it knocks on our friend’s door. 👀⚖️

Proverbs 24:23-24 (NIV)
“To show partiality in judging is not good:
Whoever says to the guilty, ‘You are innocent,’ will be cursed by peoples and denounced by nations.”
